depiction_rules.notes: In stanza 9, Yogamaya's agency is primarily conveyed through soft violet-gold waves of sleep connecting distant Gokulam, sleeping citizens, and the prison—not necessarily through a full goddess figure.

visual_bible.newborn_form: natural newborn girl wrapped in muted rose cloth
visual_bible.divine_effect: soft indigo-violet and antique-gold veil of sleep, calm rather than ominous
visual_bible.aura: subtle crescent and lotus motifs without readable symbols

never: no adult goddess unless a future stanza explicitly requires it
no sleeping Krishna in place of Yogamaya
note: Establish visually through an approved concept sheet if she becomes a recurring visible character.
